messages.text:
The verifier has moved from transformation mismatches to malformed CSV behavior.

The reference rejects uneven records with a CSV error and writes LF-only stderr, so I’m adding strict record-length validation and byte-level stderr output; this is needed for exact observable compatibility, not just nicer error text.
